shots.title: Show the paper. Ask the question.
shots.text: Lakshmi attaches the agent's brochure and asks if 15 lakh is really guaranteed.

shots.title: The council gets to work
shots.text: Muse Spark reads the paper. Code does every sum. Live on Meta's API.
shots.note: Shown 3x faster. This answer took 37 s.

shots.title: Stop.
shots.text: With the exact questions to ask the agent, and the family's own figures kept on screen, not spoken.

shots.who: The council, in the app's own voices
shots.title: Only 7.5 lakh is guaranteed
shots.text: Dani and Sankz argue from code-computed facts. The model never writes a number.

captions.text: Alfii: Let me ask Dani and Sankz.
Dani: You were told guaranteed to give 15 lakh rupees;
paper says bonuses may change each year.
Dani: Only 7.5 lakh rupees is written as guaranteed for you.
Sankz: Only 7.5 lakh rupees is guaranteed for you to get back.
Sankz: It grows on the guaranteed amount only, lower than a fixed deposit.
Alfii: Please do not take this plan as it is.
Alfii: Talk to Arun before you decide.

shots.title: Every number shows its source
shots.text: The seller's claim is checked against the paper, and each term links back to its page.

shots.title: A scam call
shots.text: Code rules catch it. No AI call is needed.

shots.title: No real bank asks for your OTP

captions.text: Alfii: Please don't share any code or pay anyone.
Alfii: Hang up and call your bank yourself.

shots.title: Arun sees the red answers
shots.text: In the guardian view he can call, or leave a note for Amma.

shots.title: Amma gets the note
shots.text: Read out to her on Home.

captions.text: Please wait for me before you sign

shots.title: The whole family's papers
shots.text: Arun's demat statement is read line by line, confirmed first. His money stays out of the family budget unless the family says so.

captions.text: Alfii: Let me ask Vick and Sankz.

shots.title: It knows what you hold
shots.text: Personal figures are spoken only when the listener is private.

captions.text: Vick: The family already holds 150 shares of this.
Vick: It jumped 222 percent in one month, so you would buy at the top.
Alfii: Please do not put money in this tip.
Alfii: Talk to Arun before you decide.

shots.title: Nothing hidden
shots.text: Router, facts, vote maths, privacy and timings for every answer, with the Meta model and reasoning level.
